CITY OF ALHAMBRA PLANNING COMMISSION
  ACTION MINUTES

  Regular Meeting
  August 1, 2022

The audio and video recordings of the meeting are available here: PC Meeting – August 1, 2022
  (Audio).m4a / PC Meeting – August 1, 2022 (Video).mp4

A.  CALL MEETING TO ORDER:  7:03 P.M. via video conference and teleconference.

B.  ROLL CALL:

  Present:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia, Gardea

  Absent:  Juarez

  Staff Present: Vanessa Reynoso, Deputy Director; Paul Lam, Principal Planner;
  Deanna Evans, Contract Associate Planner; Alondra Espinosa, Deputy City
  Attorney

C.  FLAG SALUTE:  Led by President Gardea.

D.  CONSENT AGENDA:

  •  There were no Consent Agenda items.

E.  RE-ORDER THE AGENDA:

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to re-order the Agenda to address the Public Hearing items
  before the Discussion Items.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Juarez

F.  PUBLIC HEARINGS:

  AGENDA
  ITEM 2:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-32, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-20-09 & VARIANCE VAR-21-12 (7:06 P.M.)
  • 1041 South Garfield Avenue, Suite 206
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit and Variance to allow an after school tutoring
  center (Young Crops Education Center) with less than the number of
  1
  08/1/2022
   required on-site parking spaces located on a site of approximately
  17,833 square feet in the PO (Professional Office) zone. (This
  application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act)
  •  Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-27 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-21-32, Conditional Use Permit CUP-20-09
  & Variance VAR-21-12, subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  •  Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  •  Luyu Li, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Michelle Young-Sambajon
  2.) Jende Kay Hsu

MOTION:
  •  Moved to Continue Item 2 to the September 6, 2022, Regular meeting.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Olson.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Juarez

MOTION:
  •  Moved to recess for 5 minutes.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Wang.
  •  The motion carried by the following majority vote:

  Majority Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Juarez

  •  Recess at 7:47 P.M.
  •  Reconvene at 7:51 P.M.

AGENDA
ITEM 3:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-22-06, CONDITIONAL USE
  PERMIT CUP-22-04 & VARIANCE VAR-22-02 (7:51 P.M.)
  • 441 West Main Street
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit,
  Conditional Use Permit, and Variance to establish a market with a
  Type 21 (Off-Sale General) liquor license in an existing commercial
  lease space with less than the number of required parking spaces
  located in the Commercial Planned Development (CPD) zone. (This
  application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-23 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-22-06, Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-04
  2
  08/1/2022
   & Variance VAR-22-02 subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  •  Contract Assistant Planner Alejandro De Loera provided the Staff
  presentation.
  •  Jelena Erceg, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  •  The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  •  Public Comments:
  1.) Adam Bray-Ali

MOTION:
  •  Moved to Adopt Resolution 22-23 approving Planned Development
  Permit PD-22-06, Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-04 & Variance VAR-
  22-02.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Sahu, Seconded by Commissioner Ho.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Juarez

AGENDA
ITEM 4:  CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT CUP-22-03 (8:11 P.M.)
  • 150 East Main Street, Suite 100
  • Request: This is an application for a Conditional Use Permit to permit
  an alcoholic beverage license (Type 41) for the sale of beer and wine
  in conjunction with meal service in an existing restaurant located
  within the Alhambra Place Specific Plan zone. (This application is
  exempt from the California Environmental Quality Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-22 approving
  Conditional Use Permit CUP-22-03, subject to the Conditions of
  Approval.
  • Principal Planner Paul Lam provided the Staff presentation.
  • Kevin Franklin, the Applicant’s representative, was available to
  answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Adam Bray-Ali
MOTION:
  •  Moved to adopt Resolution 22-22 approving Conditional Use Permit
  CUP-22-03.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Juarez

  3
  08/1/2022
   AGENDA
  ITEM 5:  PLANNED DEVELOPMENT PERMIT PD-21-03 & TENTATIVE TRACT
  MAP TTM-21-04 (8:20 P.M.)
  • 205-207 South Marguerita Avenue
  • Request: This is an application for a Planned Development Permit
  PD-21-03 and Tentative Tract Map TTM-21-04 to develop a new 7-
  unit condominium development on a site of approximately 13,197
  square feet located in the R-3 (Multiple Family Residential) zone.
  (This application is exempt from the California Environmental Quality
  Act.)
  • Recommended Action: Adopt Resolution 22-24 approving Planned
  Development Permit PD-21-03 and Tentative Tract Map TTM-21-04,
  subject to the Conditions of Approval.
  • Contract Planner Deanna Evans provided the Staff presentation.
  • Feng Xiao, the Applicant, was available to answer questions.
  • The public hearing was opened and then closed.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng

  MOTION:
  •  Moved to adopt Resolution 22-24 approving Planned Development
  Permit PD-21-03 and Tentative Tract Map TTM-21-04 with one (1)
  additional condition of approval: the applicant/developer shall engage
  the services of an architectural salvage company. A copy of the contract
  between the applicant/developer and the architectural salvage company
  shall be provided to the Planning Division prior to issuance of the
  demolition permit.
  •  Moved by Commissioner Olson, Seconded by Commissioner Sahu.
  •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:

  Roll Call Vote: 9-0-0-1
  Ayes:  Ho, Mojarro, Olson, Pham, Sahu, Tsujii, Wang, Garcia,
  Gardea
  Noes:  None
  Abstain: None
  Absent:  Juarez

G.  DISCUSSION ITEMS

  AGENDA
  ITEM 1:  PRESENTATION SERIES ON THE COMPREHENSIVE ZONING CODE
  UPDATE (8:49 P.M.)
  • Request: This is the first presentation in a series of presentations on
  the Comprehensive Zoning Code update project presented by
  Planning Division Staff.
  • Recommended Action: It is recommended that the Planning
  Commission receive and file this informational report and provide
  input to Staff as deemed appropriate.
  • Public Comments:
  1.) Jennifer Ng
  2.) Lewis McCammon
  3.) Ari Gutierrez Arambula
  4
  08/1/2022
   4.) Hanshi Lee
  5.) Olga Alarid
  6.) Bert Ng

H.  DIRECTOR’S REPORT:

  •  Deputy Director Vanessa Reynoso thanked the Commission and community for
  bearing with any technical difficulties or delays in the online meeting, along with any
  comments and feedback regarding the Zoning Code update. (10:34 P.M.)

I.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  •  There were no Oral Communications.

J.  COMMISSION COMMUNICATIONS/ANNOUNCEMENTS:

  •  Commissioner Wang commented that she would like to look at the applications
  regarding IHO. (10:36 P.M.)

K.  ADJOURNMENT:

  •  There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 10:38 P.M. to Monday,
  August 15, 2022, at 7:00 P.M.

  _______________________________
  Chris Olson
  President
